output.outcome: stopReason of the last assistant message (stop, length, error, aborted); the exit code stays 0 on errors
output.tokens: the sum of usage.totalTokens of assistant messages; unknown when stopped
output.cost: usage.cost.total of each assistant message, priced by Pi from its own model list: above 0, the request was priced as paid; 0 does not prove a free request

notes: Pi sends about 4,600 tokens of system prompt with every request.
Pi has no permission rules: read_only gives it only its reading tools, which can still read any path named to them, so a task should not name paths outside the workspace.
